import {
  AccessTime,
  Coffee,
  Email,
  LocationOn,
  Phone,
} from "@mui/icons-material";
import {
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Chip,
  Grid,
  Paper,
  Rating,
  Stack,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import React from "react";

const DemoPreview: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        background:
          "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B4513 0%, #D2691E 50%, #F4A460 100%)",
        borderRadius: 3,
        p: 3,
        color: "white",
        position: "relative",
        overflow: "hidden",
        "&::before": {
          content: '""',
          position: "absolute",
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          background:
            'url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width="60" height="60" viewBox="0 0 60 60" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"%3E%3Cg fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd"%3E%3Cg fill="%23ffffff" fill-opacity="0.05"%3E%3Ccircle cx="30" cy="30" r="4"/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E")',
          opacity: 0.3,
        },
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={2} mb={3}>
          <Avatar
            sx={{ bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)", width: 56, height: 56 }}
          >
            <Coffee sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />
          </Avatar>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="h4" fontWeight={700}>
              Brew & Bean Café
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ opacity: 0.9 }}>
              Artisan Coffee & Fresh Pastries
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>

        {/* Hero Section Preview */}
        <Paper
          elevation={0}
          sx={{
            background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
            backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
            p: 3,
            borderRadius: 2,
            mb: 3,
            border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="h5" fontWeight={600} mb={2}>
            Welcome to Our Cozy Corner
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ opacity: 0.9, mb: 2 }}>
            Experience the perfect blend of premium coffee and warm hospitality
            in the heart of downtown.
          </Typography>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{
              background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
              "&:hover": { background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)" },
            }}
          >
            View Menu
          </Button>
        </Paper>

        {/* Menu Preview */}
        <Grid container spacing={2} mb={3}>
          <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
            <Card
              elevation={0}
              sx={{
                background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
                backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
                border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
              }}
            >
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={600} mb={2}>
                  Featured Menu
                </Typography>
                <Stack spacing={2}>
                  {[
                    { name: "Signature Espresso", price: "$4.50" },
                    { name: "Caramel Macchiato", price: "$5.25" },
                    { name: "Fresh Croissant", price: "$3.75" },
                  ].map((item, i) => (
                    <Stack
                      key={i}
                      direction="row"
                      justifyContent="space-between"
                    >
                      <Typography variant="body2">{item.name}</Typography>
                      <Chip
                        label={item.price}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)" }}
                      />
                    </Stack>
                  ))}
                </Stack>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>

          <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
            <Card
              elevation={0}
              sx={{
                background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
                backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
                border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
              }}
            >
              <CardContent>
                <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={600} mb={2}>
                  Customer Reviews
                </Typography>
                <Stack spacing={2}>
                  <Box>
                    <Rating value={5} size="small" readOnly />
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.9 }}>
                      "Amazing coffee and friendly staff!"
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ opacity: 0.7 }}>
                      - Sarah M.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box>
                    <Rating value={5} size="small" readOnly />
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.9 }}>
                      "Perfect spot for morning meetings."
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ opacity: 0.7 }}>
                      - John D.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                </Stack>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>

        {/* Contact Info Preview */}
        <Paper
          elevation={0}
          sx={{
            background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
            backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
            p: 2,
            borderRadius: 2,
            border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={600} mb={2}>
            Visit Us Today
          </Typography>
          <Grid container spacing={2}>
            <Grid item xs={12} sm={6}>
              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={1}>
                <LocationOn sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="body2">
                  123 Coffee Street, Downtown
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12} sm={6}>
              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={1}>
                <AccessTime sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="body2">Mon-Fri: 7AM-8PM</Typography>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12} sm={6}>
              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={1}>
                <Phone sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="body2">(555) 123-BREW</Typography>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12} sm={6}>
              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={1}>
                <Email sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="body2">hello@brewbean.com</Typography>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </Paper>

        {/* Preview Badge */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: "absolute",
            top: 16,
            right: 16,
            background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
            backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
            px: 2,
            py: 1,
            borderRadius: 2,
            border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3)",
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="caption" fontWeight={600}>
            PREVIEW
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default DemoPreview;
